players.product: DDR5 RCD / DB, MRDIMM MRCD / MDB, CXL memory-expander controllers and PCIe retimers

quarterly_data.signal: Montage Technology announced on September 28, 2026 that its fifth-sub-generation DDR5 registering clock driver chip (RCD05) has entered mass production. Compliant with the JEDEC DDR5RCD05 specification, it supports 8000 MT/s, about 11% higher than the prior-generation RCD04, and targets high-performance DDR5 RDIMMs for data centers and AI servers. President Stephen Tai called the mass production an important result of the company's work in DDR5 memory interface chips.
quarterly_data.figure: RCD05 at 8000 MT/s, about 11% above RCD04; mass production
